profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack | CS @ NYU ‘24
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Software Engineer at Capgemini. I’m experienced in designing scalable backend systems and full-stack applications. Over the past 3+ years, I’ve built solutions in Python/JS/TS, integrating AI workflows, and cloud infrastructure (AWS) for real-time processing pipelines. I'm focused on delivering efficient and maintainable systems that bridges data into actionable insights.

👥 Feel free to connect with me here
🎾 Outside of programming: I enjoy playing tennis/basketball, going to movies/concerts, and reading.
📝 View my website for additional info: https://jladrover.github.io

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Developing/deploying innovative software solutions for financial services clients at Capgemini.  
• Engaged in full-stack development, utilizing generative AI and machine learning technologies.  
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance internal processes and client offerings.

positions.title: Full-Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, implemented, and tested a social media iOS app for AI imagery using Swift and Django, leveraging AWS EC2, RDS, and S3 for processing and storage solutions.
• Collaborated with engineers for API development and integration, utilizing CloudFront for content delivery.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Systems Design and +4 skills

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.locationName: Greenwich, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Facilitated community development and administrative responsibilities within the resource center at Greenwich Hall.
• Leveraged Pandas library to process data and streamline check-out operations for over 300 residents.
positions.insights: Resource Management, Collaborative Work and +3 skills

positions.title: Python Course Instructor
positions.description:
• Mentored multiple international undergraduate students from Wilfrid Laurier University & Centennial College through introductory Python courses online, achieving grade increases as high as 20%
• Addressed inquiries from general programming topics to areas such as object-oriented programming (OOP) and data analysis through Pandas, NumPy, & Matplotlib
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and +4 skills
